skills.name: Programming/software development
skills.description: Developing software components to deliver value to stakeholders. Designing, coding, verifying, testing, documenting, amending and refactoring programs and scripts.

levels.2: Designs, codes, verifies, tests and documents simple programs or scripts under direction.
levels.3: Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, amends and refactors moderately complex programs and scripts.
levels.4: Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, amends and refactors complex programs and scripts. Applies agreed standards and tools.
levels.5: Takes technical responsibility across all stages and iterations of software development. Plans and drives software construction activities.

skills.name: Data modelling and design
skills.description: Developing models and diagrams to represent and communicate data requirements and data assets.

levels.3: Applies data analysis and data modelling techniques, based on documented business needs, to establish and maintain data models.
levels.4: Investigates enterprise data requirements and specifies data structures based on standards and guidelines.
levels.5: Sets standards for data modelling and design tools and techniques and advises on their application.

skills.name: Machine learning
skills.description: Developing systems that learn through experience and by the use of data.

levels.3: Assists in the development of machine learning solutions under supervision. Prepares data sets and runs defined experiments.
levels.4: Designs and builds machine learning solutions for defined problems. Selects appropriate algorithms and validates models.
levels.5: Leads the development of machine learning approaches. Sets direction for model selection, evaluation and deployment.
levels.6: Directs the organisation's adoption of machine learning. Establishes policy and governance for responsible use.

skills.name: Database administration
skills.description: Installing, configuring, monitoring, maintaining and improving the performance of databases and data stores.

levels.2: Assists in database support activities under routine supervision.
levels.3: Performs standard database maintenance and administration tasks. Uses database management system software and tools to collect performance statistics.
levels.4: Develops and configures tools to enable automation of database administration tasks. Monitors performance statistics and identifies improvements.

skills.name: Information security
skills.description: Defining and operating a framework of security controls and security management strategies.

levels.3: Applies and maintains specific security controls as required by organisational policy.
levels.4: Provides guidance on the application and operation of elementary physical, procedural and technical security controls.
levels.5: Provides advice and guidance on security strategies to manage identified risks and ensure adoption of security standards.
levels.6: Develops and communicates corporate information security policy, standards and guidelines.

skills.name: Testing
skills.description: Investigating products, systems and services to assess behaviour and whether this meets specified or unspecified requirements and characteristics.

levels.1: Executes given test scripts under supervision. Records results and reports issues.
levels.2: Defines test conditions for given requirements. Designs test cases and creates test scripts and supporting data.
levels.3: Reviews requirements and specifications and defines test conditions. Analyses and reports test activities and results.
levels.4: Accepts responsibility for creation of test cases using own in-depth technical analysis of both functional and non-functional specifications.

skills.name: Solution architecture
skills.description: Developing and communicating a multi-dimensional solution architecture to deliver agreed business outcomes.

levels.4: Contributes to the development of solution architectures in specific business, infrastructure or functional areas.
levels.5: Leads the development of solution architectures in specific business, infrastructure or functional areas.
levels.6: Leads the development of architectures for complex solutions, ensuring consistency with specified requirements agreed with both external and internal customers.

skills.name: People management
skills.description: Managing people day to day and over their organisational life cycle.

levels.4: Supervises individuals and teams. Allocates routine tasks or project work. Provides direction, support and guidance.
levels.5: Provides coherent direction to individuals and teams on performance and development.
levels.6: Develops and communicates people management strategies aligned with organisational goals.
